description: This file provides utility functions for parsing, comparing, and managing release version strings and related npm publish configurations, including regex patterns for semantic version parsing, version comparison logic, and authentication handling for npm dist tags.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses date components from a version string using regex match groups and constructs a ParsedReleaseVersion object if valid.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object, supporting stable, beta, and correction versions.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings by parsing them and comparing their date and version components.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines npm publish configuration plan (channel and tags) based on the version string and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves and validates npm dist tag mirror authentication tokens from provided parameters.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Decides whether npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and existing auth.
